layers.note: An invasive bramble that takes over disturbed open ground, field edges, clearings and stream banks.

elevation_m.note: Sea level to about 600 m in western Washington; the upper limits are loose.

max_slope_deg.note: Grows on flats and moderate slopes.

shade_tolerance.note: Needs full sun; dies back under canopy.
